classification: writes/reassigns financial-value meaning, CONDITIONALLY (harmless on this input: the fold's gate never opens)
what_does_not_change: a fused header row whose LAST cell reads BALANCE (not AMOUNT) never satisfies the gate (`hL.group(1) == "AMOUNT"`), so the whole table -- DEBIT and BALANCE columns included -- is left byte-for-byte untouched
semantics_note: the gate's own narrowness is what makes debit_credit_balance_folded a CONDITIONAL hazard rather than an unconditional one: it only opens when the table's fused header's OWN last word literally reads AMOUNT. A table whose last column is honestly labeled BALANCE (the common real-world shape) is safe. The condition is still constructible (an OCR misread of the header word, or a genuine AMOUNT-labeled running-total column beside a DEBIT column), which is why this census classifies the function as conditionally hazardous rather than safe
